measure.explanation: Independent sellers facing the same costs still disagree on price, because they buy at different times and carry different stock. This measure is the day-to-day spread of prices across sellers in one location. A spread that stays near zero for weeks is what a single repeated price looks like.

caseFile.summary: Prices from 363 observations across the location stayed within 0.2% of one another for 71 days, against a 3.0% threshold; median +28% relative to the reference rate while peer locations Bagayam, Sathuvachari and 1 other remained in-band.
caseFile.caveat: This document records a statistical pattern flagged for investigation. It does not establish that any party has set prices unlawfully. Sellers are identified only by pseudonymous location codes.

referenceRate.citation: National Egg Coordination Committee — suggested daily egg rate, Namakkal zone (suggestive, not mandatory)

measure.explanation: A competitive price moves when costs move. This measure compares how closely each seller's price follows its neighbours' prices against how closely it follows the published reference rate. A price that follows the neighbours and ignores the reference rate is the pattern this system exists to surface.

caseFile.summary: Listed prices follow one another (correlation 0.91) far more closely than they follow the reference rate (correlation -0.21); median +28% relative to the reference rate while peer locations Bagayam, Sathuvachari and 1 other remained in-band.
caseFile.caveat: This document records a statistical pattern flagged for investigation. It does not establish that any party has set prices unlawfully. Sellers are identified only by pseudonymous location codes.

measure.explanation: Any location can sit above its expected range for a day. measure.explanation: A metered fare varies continuously with distance. This measure reports the share of quoted fares landing on round multiples, together with how much of the fare is explained by distance at all. Round numbers with weak distance response describe a fare that was set rather than measured.

caseFile.summary: Quoted fares cluster at round values (93% of quotes) with weak distance sensitivity (R² 0.24); median +29% relative to the notified rate while peer locations Bagayam, Sathuvachari and 1 other remained in-band.
caseFile.caveat: This document records a statistical pattern flagged for investigation. It does not establish that any party has set prices unlawfully. Sellers are identified only by pseudonymous location codes.
